## Featured updates

[Image of a person flushing their dental unit waterlines using the A-dec Flush Dock over a sink]

#### How to Clean and Maintain Dental Unit Waterlines

Learn a clear, step-by-step approach to dental unit waterline (DUWL) maintenance—from choosing the
right water source to monitoring, shocking, and flushing treatments.

[Read article][128]
[A dental office employee looking at the Link AI inbox]

#### AI Dental Receptionist: Turn Missed Calls Into Revenue

Learn how AI dental receptionist software helps streamline scheduling, communication, and front desk
workflows.

[Read article][129]
[A-dec Impact logo]

#### A-dec Donates $1 Million to Dental Trade Alliance Foundation

A‑dec announced a transformative $1,000,000 endowment, in partnership with The Dental Trade Alliance
Foundation.

[Read press release][130]
[A-dec and Dentsply Sirona collaboration logos]

#### A-dec and Dentsply Sirona Expand Partnership

A‑dec and Dentsply Sirona expand their strategic partnership by integrating the Midwest Motor System
into A‑dec Pro delivery systems.

[Read press release][131]
[Two curved dark blue arrows containing the words A-dec Buyback Program]

#### A‑dec Buyback Program

Get cash back for your used A‑dec dental equipment.

[Learn more][132]
[Townie awards for A-dec dental equipment]

#### Thank you, Townie dentists

Since 2003, Dentaltown magazine's online community of dental professionals has consistently named
A‑dec products as the best across multiple categories.

[About the awards][133]
[3D visualization of A-dec dental equipment coming out of a phone]

#### 5 Tips and Tricks for Dream in 3D

From starting with a blank room or uploading photos of an existing space, to using AI-generated
color palettes, AR/VR visualization, and easy sharing tools, see how doctors can plan their
operatories with confidence.

[Read article][134]

## A-dec+ connected dentistry

Simple. Reliable. Intuitive. Imagine an updatable software platform that keeps your dental practice
ready for whatever lies ahead.

[Explore A-dec+][135]
[A-dec+ web and mobile application]

## Featured resources

Dream in 3D

Explore A‑dec dental equipment in 3D, and see products in your space with AR. Customize colors and
materials, and order free color samples.

[Explore Dream in 3D][136]

Order color samples

Order free A‑dec upholstery and cabinet color samples.

[Find your perfect color][137]

A‑dec buyback program

Get cash back for your A‑dec dental equipment—and get our best deal when you purchase new A‑dec
equipment at the same time.

[A-dec buyback program][138]

Customer stories

Hear why doctors choose A‑dec dental equipment to design healthy, comfortable, and high-quality
dental office experiences.

[Watch videos][139]

All Rights Reserved. ## Larry Cohen **CHIEF CUSTOMER ADVOCATE** Larry Cohen graduated from Wilkes College with a B.S. in Accounting in 1957 and Columbia University Graduate School of Business, earning an M.S. in Management and Finance, 1958. He served in the U. S. Army Reserve from 1958 through 1964. He is the second-generation owner of Benco Dental Company, which was founded by his father, Benjamin Cohen in 1930. Joining Benco Dental in 1959 as manager of the Tooth Department, in 1960, Larry became an outside sales rep, a position he enjoyed full time until 1972. Beginning that year, Larry began reducing his outside sales role and increasing his managerial duties, later becoming the president of Benco Dental from 1965 - 1996. Larry is the Founder of the American Dental Cooperative; Board, American Dental Trade Associate, plus Various ADTA committees. He sits on the Board of Wilkes University, Board of Visiting Nurses Association and the Board of Jewish Community Center. He served in the U. S. Army Reserve from 1958 through 1964. He is the second-generation owner of Benco Dental Company, which was founded by his father, Benjamin Cohen in 1930. Joining Benco Dental in 1959 as manager of the Tooth Department, in 1960, Larry became an outside sales rep, a position he enjoyed full time until 1972. Beginning that year, Larry began reducing his outside sales role and increasing his managerial duties, later becoming the president of Benco Dental from 1965 - 1996. Larry is the Founder of the American Dental Cooperative; Board, American Dental Trade Associate, plus Various ADTA committees. He sits on the Board of Wilkes University, Board of Visiting Nurses Association and the Board of Jewish Community Center. with a comprehensive range of tools and materials that are easy to use and streamline workflows.

### mouthpieces.

Engineered for optimal patient comfort and clinical efficiency, Isolite's patented single-use

sizes to accommodate patients of all ages, these precision-crafted mouthpieces ensure reliable

The NEW biodegradable HOOPLA™ Retractor maximizes oral cavity access and visibility by comfortably
retracting a patient’s lips and cheeks during restorative, hygiene, cosmetic, and orthodontic
procedures.

Compatible with Zyris Isolite Posterior Mouthpieces and suction devices or for use on any dental
procedure.

# 80 Million Patients Protected

For over 25 years, clinicians have trusted Zyris® to help them provide better dentistry, in less
time.

### A Modern Approach to Efficient Dentistry

The Isolite® System is your all-in-one solution for efficient dentistry. From visibility to moisture
control and patient compliance, every feature is designed to help you do better dentistry, in less
time. Practices using Isolite are reducing procedure time by up to 48%.



[Learn More About the Isolite System][133]

Nothing reduces humidity like the Isolite system. Rubber dams and cotton rolls are great, but there
is nothing that gives us total control over the oral environment in so many applications as Isolite.
We couldn’t practice without it.
Drs. Michael Melkers and Jeanine McDonald

### Seeing is Believing! Get an Online Demo of the Isolite.

Ready to see how the Isolite system can help your dental practice?


[Click Here To Get Started][134]

### Gain more control of the oral environment with our dual-quadrant and bicuspid-to-bicuspid
### mouthpieces.

Engineered for optimal patient comfort and clinical efficiency, Isolite's patented single-use
mouthpieces are designed to follow the natural contours of the oral cavity. Available in multiple
sizes to accommodate patients of all ages, these precision-crafted mouthpieces ensure reliable
isolation for both posterior and anterior procedures.

[Learn More About Zyris Mouthpieces][135]

### Introducing....HOOPLA™

The NEW biodegradable HOOPLA™ Retractor maximizes oral cavity access and visibility by comfortably
retracting a patient’s lips and cheeks during restorative, hygiene, cosmetic, and orthodontic
procedures.

Compatible with Zyris Isolite Posterior Mouthpieces and suction devices or for use on any dental
procedure.

So simple and comfortable to use, your patient could insert it themselves in seconds!

Annapolis Dental Center was founded by Dr. Kennedy R. Dele. Dr. Dele remains committed to a gentle
and caring approach that focuses on esthetic beauty and the long lasting health of your smile. At
Annapolis Dental Center we understand the connection between the health of your mouth to overall
wellness and go to great lengths to provide the most comprehensive, advanced care available in a
comfortable personalized environment.

The team at Annapolis Dental Center say that it is never too late to take the steps to eradicate
past decay or trauma, rejuvenate your teeth and feel content, happy, and most of all confident with
your smile.

You may know that you don’t like your smile but helping you realize what you are looking for in a
new and improved one is the passion of Dr. Dele and his team.

Dr. Dele and his staff have as a core belief that every person can have a special and uniquely
beautiful smile that enhances their appearance and demeanor. Through the use of the latest
technology and a calming professional presence they will help you design and achieve the dream of
your own signature “perfect smile”.

Dr. Dele's skills have been sharpened by many hours of comprehensive, advanced post-graduate, hands
on intensive clinical training in cosmetic dentistry and the latest techniques in all phases of
general dentistry. Dr. Dele has an abiding belief that dentistry is a great way to reach individuals
by way of discovery. Annapolis Dental Center believes that an accurate diagnoses is a joint effort.
With your help the team will gather all the necessary information and work with you to develop a
treatment strategy that will address your needs and preferences. This collaboration puts you in
charge of your own dental health and allows you to feel relaxed, comfortable, and most of all
confident in your treatment choices. The team takes great pride in a co-discovery process that
educates, creates awareness, and allows them to advocate your health, confidence, and trust for a
lifetime of dental care and wellness.

## Reasons to Visit Our Clinic

##### Flexible Hours for Your Convenience

Annapolis Dental Center offers convenient hours and provides a variety of dental procedures and
treatments.

##### State-of-the-Art Treatment

Advanced digital dental technology has grown over the last few years and we believe that investing
in the latest dental technology and learning how to use it appropriately will lead to better
treatments for our patients.

##### High Quality Care for Your Family

Our goal here is to provide the highest quality dental care in a family-based, high-technology
practice.

##### Dedicated to Our Community

We love helping people, whether it is alleviating their pain or creating a beautiful smile. Here at
Annapolis Dental Center, we are dedicated to giving each of our patients the healthy smile they
deserve!

##### Payment Plans Made Easy

At Annapolis Dental Center we are committed to providing superior dental services with affordable
payment plans designed to fit any budget.

##### Professional, Personalized Environment

Dr. Dele and his team understand the connection between the health of your mouth to overall wellness
and go that extra mile to provide the most comprehensive, advanced care available.

View More

## Our Range of Dental Care Services


[

##### Teeth Whitening

Having a beautiful smile may be even easier than you think. Many people achieve the look they’ve
been dreaming of with our simple “bleaching” procedure.

][6]
[

##### Restorations

Through improved techniques and modern technology, we are now able to offer more options for
restoring a tooth back to its normal shape, appearance and function.

][7]
[

##### Comprehensive Dentistry

Regular visits to our office ensure that your teeth and mouth remain as healthy as possible. We
provide thorough examinations and cleanings to our patients.

][8]
[

##### Implant Restoration

Dental Implants are a new alternative in tooth replacement. Any implant procedure is preceded by a
detailed consultation and case planning with your dental team.

][9]
[

##### Cosmetic Dentistry

At Annapolis Dental Center we use the proper material to fit the need presented. Our procedures
include cosmetic bonding, porcelain crowns, porcelain veneers and tooth whitening.

][10]
[

##### Emergency Service

No matter how careful you might be, accidents can happen and when they affect your smile, you need
the assurance and results that only emergency dental care can provide.

][11]

### High Innovative Technology & Professional Dentists

At Annapolis Dental Center we value your time and make it easy to book an appointment for care! You
can either reach out to us with a phone call or submit this simple, online form. We respond promptly
to all online requests.

[Request an Appointment][12]

Our mission at Annapolis Dental Center is to deliver happiness through the creation and maintenance
of healthy and beautiful smiles.

Annapolis Dental Center was founded by Dr. Kennedy R. Dele. Dr. Dele remains committed to a gentle
and caring approach that focuses on esthetic beauty and the long lasting health of your smile. At
Annapolis Dental Center we understand the connection between the health of your mouth to overall
wellness and go to great lengths to provide the most comprehensive, advanced care available in a
comfortable personalized environment.

The team at Annapolis Dental Center say that it is never too late to take the steps to eradicate
past decay or trauma, rejuvenate your teeth and feel content, happy, and most of all confident with
your smile.

You may know that you don’t like your smile but helping you realize what you are looking for in a
new and improved one is the passion of Dr. Dele and his team.

Dr. Dele and his staff have as a core belief that every person can have a special and uniquely
beautiful smile that enhances their appearance and demeanor. Through the use of the latest
technology and a calming professional presence they will help you design and achieve the dream of
your own signature “perfect smile”.

Dr. Dele's skills have been sharpened by many hours of comprehensive, advanced post-graduate, hands
on intensive clinical training in cosmetic dentistry and the latest techniques in all phases of
general dentistry. Dr. Dele has an abiding belief that dentistry is a great way to reach individuals
by way of discovery. Annapolis Dental Center believes that an accurate diagnoses is a joint effort.
With your help the team will gather all the necessary information and work with you to develop a
treatment strategy that will address your needs and preferences. This collaboration puts you in
charge of your own dental health and allows you to feel relaxed, comfortable, and most of all
confident in your treatment choices. The team takes great pride in a co-discovery process that
educates, creates awareness, and allows them to advocate your health, confidence, and trust for a
lifetime of dental care and wellness.

## Reasons to Visit Our Clinic

##### Flexible Hours for Your Convenience

Annapolis Dental Center offers convenient hours and provides a variety of dental procedures and
treatments.

##### State-of-the-Art Treatment

Advanced digital dental technology has grown over the last few years and we believe that investing
in the latest dental technology and learning how to use it appropriately will lead to better
treatments for our patients.

##### High Quality Care for Your Family

Our goal here is to provide the highest quality dental care in a family-based, high-technology
practice.

##### Dedicated to Our Community

We love helping people, whether it is alleviating their pain or creating a beautiful smile. Here at
Annapolis Dental Center, we are dedicated to giving each of our patients the healthy smile they
deserve!

##### Payment Plans Made Easy

At Annapolis Dental Center we are committed to providing superior dental services with affordable
payment plans designed to fit any budget.

##### Professional, Personalized Environment

Dr. Dele and his team understand the connection between the health of your mouth to overall wellness
and go that extra mile to provide the most comprehensive, advanced care available.

View More

## Our Range of Dental Care Services


[

##### Teeth Whitening

Having a beautiful smile may be even easier than you think. Many people achieve the look they’ve
been dreaming of with our simple “bleaching” procedure.

][6]
[

##### Restorations

Through improved techniques and modern technology, we are now able to offer more options for
restoring a tooth back to its normal shape, appearance and function.

][7]
[

##### Comprehensive Dentistry

Regular visits to our office ensure that your teeth and mouth remain as healthy as possible. We
provide thorough examinations and cleanings to our patients.

][8]
[

##### Implant Restoration

Dental Implants are a new alternative in tooth replacement. Any implant procedure is preceded by a
detailed consultation and case planning with your dental team.

][9]
[

##### Cosmetic Dentistry

At Annapolis Dental Center we use the proper material to fit the need presented. Our procedures
include cosmetic bonding, porcelain crowns, porcelain veneers and tooth whitening.

][10]
[

##### Emergency Service

No matter how careful you might be, accidents can happen and when they affect your smile, you need
the assurance and results that only emergency dental care can provide.

][11]
View More

### High Innovative Technology & Professional Dentists

At Annapolis Dental Center we value your time and make it easy to book an appointment for care! You
can either reach out to us with a phone call or submit this simple, online form. We respond promptly
to all online requests.

[Request an Appointment][12]

Our mission at Annapolis Dental Center is to deliver happiness through the creation and maintenance
of healthy and beautiful smiles.

  * [Dental & OMS*In oral and maxillofacial surgery (OMF), precise work over long periods of time is
    essential. This is because complicated and time-consuming procedures are not uncommon in oral
    surgery, maxillofacial surgery and implantology. Interventions over long periods of time also
    require the fullest concentration of oral surgeons over the entire period. BRUMABA products
    support you precisely in these demanding activities by providing the best possible access to
    your area of operation. Even during apicoectomies on tooth 37 / 47, a sinus lift or a wisdom
    tooth removal in the maxilla, the BRUMABA operating table can be adjusted so that you have ideal
    access to the surgical site. The simple and intuitive handling of our tables facilitates the
    entire surgical procedure – from preparation to hygienic reprocessing after surgery. Patients
    benefit from ergonomically shaped cushions through to a specially shaped and flexibly mounted
    headrest, which makes even long procedures more pleasant by providing maximum comfort. We know
    the requirements for a perfectly equipped operating room in the oral surgery practice or oral
    clinic and will be happy to advise you on the choice of the ideal BRUMABA product.*][40]
  * [Ophthalmology*Surgical interventions in the eye area (ophthalmology), such as glaucoma
    operations, cataract operations or eye muscle operations, require a high degree of flexibility
    in terms of accessibility to the eye and reliable stability during the very difficult operation.
    To make the workplace ideal for the surgeon, BRUMABA operating tables and operating chairs offer
    handling tailored to this specific use. Thus, they allow an ergonomic working posture for the
    medical team at all times, as well as relaxed positioning for the patient. Finely adjustable
    armrest settings on BRUMABA operating chairs provide comfortable support during longer
    procedures. The almost unrestricted mobility of BRUMABA operating tables also enables efficient
    and economical OR organization, as rapid rotation is possible in inpatient or practice
    operations (especially when using multiple OR tables). We at BRUMABA have gained experience with
    our products in ophthalmology for many years and will be happy to advise you in choosing the
    ideal BRUMABA product.*][41]
  * [Aesthetics*Aesthetic, plastic and reconstructive surgery includes procedures on the entire
    body: from hair transplantation, eyelid lift, nose correction or breast augmentation to
    abdominoplasty or scar correction – to name just a few examples. Procedures are performed both
    on an outpatient and inpatient basis and can be both personally and medically motivated. With
    our proven BRUMABA operating tables and operating chairs, we provide the ideal basis for the
    surgical steps especially for these often difficult applications. Because regardless of whether
    it is supine positioning, lateral positioning or abdominal positioning – thanks to the
    configurable positions, the surgeon always has optimal access to the patient and to the
    corresponding body region. This is also the case regardless of whether the surgeon prefers to
    perform the operation in a sitting or standing position. Sophisticated functionalities combined
    with easy handling and a wide range of accessories allow a perfect surgical procedure from
    preparation to cleaning. And for patients too, operating tables from BRUMABA ensure perfect
    relaxation thanks to particularly comfortable positioning on extra-soft, ergonomically shaped
    cushions. We will be happy to advise you on the choice of the ideal BRUMABA product and give you
    an overview of individual equipment options.*][42]
  * [Dermatology*Thanks to our close cooperation with dermatologists, we are able to understand your
    needs and ideas and develop individual solutions. Our specially designed BRUMABA operating
    tables and operating chairs offer customized solutions for dermatology / dermatosurgery and are
    an indispensable tool to provide you and your team with pleasant and ergonomic comfort even
    during longer operations.*][43]
  * [Orthopedics*The number of orthopedic and outpatient surgeries is increasing – among other
    things due to minimally invasive methods and the patient’s wish for a convalescence / recovery
    phase at home. Whether in day clinics, surgery clinics or in the practice – the outpatient
    specialties require the greatest possible flexibility in every case. The expectation of economic
    efficiency, uncompromising mobility and easy handling as well as hygienic cleaning of work
    equipment is therefore particularly high. A wide variety of requirements, from complicated or
    time-consuming surgical procedures to the need for a wide range of storage options and special
    economic efficiency, are optimally harmonized by BRUMABA products. They ensure a smooth process,
    from the preparation for surgery to the subsequent cleaning for the next operation. Among other
    things, recurring and complex storage procedures can be conveniently stored. And thanks to the
    extensive range of accessories, you equip each operating table entirely according to your needs.
    As entrepreneurs, we also have an eye on cost-effectiveness and can give you optimal advice. We
    would also be happy to come by in person and get an initial overview at your practice or
    clinic.*][44]
  * [Outpatient surgery*Numerous feedback and suggestions from surgeons in outpatient surgery
    centers are invaluable to us at BRUMABA. They help us to design innovative operating tables that
    are optimally tailored to your needs. With the help of your expertise, we not only refine our
    products technically, but also offer you the best comfort, highly functional ergonomics and
    maximum safety.*][45]
  * [ENT*Special solutions for ear, nose and throat (ENT) surgery make BRUMABA operating tables and
    operating chairs an indispensable tool for the operating area or procedure room. For example,
    for optimized head positioning during surgery on the tonsil organs, nasal septum, or middle ear:
    the narrow headrest on the operating table allows a better view of the surgical field with an
    ideal surgical distance without having to assume a stooped posture as a surgeon. The
    interoperatively precisely adjustable and easy-to-fix head tray enables particularly stable head
    positioning. The foot switch on the operating table is also particularly practical for
    consistent sterility and automated procedures. It allows functions to be self-regulated – a
    total of 8 memory programs are available that can be individually configured. Thanks to the
    unrestricted mobility of the BRUMABA operating tables, they can also be used for patient
    preparation as well as for transport or the recovery phase – without having to reposition the
    patient. Our BRUMABA products are already successfully in use in numerous ENT clinics and
    practices. We would be pleased to inform you about our portfolio and the many different
    possibilities for your individual configuration.*][46]
  * [Endodontics*Treatment tables and microsurgery chairs from BRUMABA enable an ideal working
    position and back-friendly treatment at the microscope for the doctor and assistant. Work safety
    is increased by an integrated microsurgery ring close to the head and individually adjustable
    forearm supports. Viscoelastic padding and flexible reclining positions ensure professional and
    comfortable patient positioning up to 300 kg.*][47]

    Due to their slim design, our mobile operating tables offer optimum legroom, regardless of

  * [Dental & OMS*In oral and maxillofacial surgery (OMF), precise work over long periods of time is
    essential. This is because complicated and time-consuming procedures are not uncommon in oral
    surgery, maxillofacial surgery and implantology. Interventions over long periods of time also
    require the fullest concentration of oral surgeons over the entire period. BRUMABA products
    support you precisely in these demanding activities by providing the best possible access to
    your area of operation. Even during apicoectomies on tooth 37 / 47, a sinus lift or a wisdom
    tooth removal in the maxilla, the BRUMABA operating table can be adjusted so that you have ideal
    access to the surgical site. The simple and intuitive handling of our tables facilitates the
    entire surgical procedure – from preparation to hygienic reprocessing after surgery. Patients
    benefit from ergonomically shaped cushions through to a specially shaped and flexibly mounted
    headrest, which makes even long procedures more pleasant by providing maximum comfort. We know
    the requirements for a perfectly equipped operating room in the oral surgery practice or oral
    clinic and will be happy to advise you on the choice of the ideal BRUMABA product.*][40]
  * [Ophthalmology*Surgical interventions in the eye area (ophthalmology), such as glaucoma
    operations, cataract operations or eye muscle operations, require a high degree of flexibility
    in terms of accessibility to the eye and reliable stability during the very difficult operation.
    To make the workplace ideal for the surgeon, BRUMABA operating tables and operating chairs offer
    handling tailored to this specific use. Thus, they allow an ergonomic working posture for the
    medical team at all times, as well as relaxed positioning for the patient. Finely adjustable
    armrest settings on BRUMABA operating chairs provide comfortable support during longer
    procedures. The almost unrestricted mobility of BRUMABA operating tables also enables efficient
    and economical OR organization, as rapid rotation is possible in inpatient or practice
    operations (especially when using multiple OR tables). We at BRUMABA have gained experience with
    our products in ophthalmology for many years and will be happy to advise you in choosing the
    ideal BRUMABA product.*][41]
  * [Aesthetics*Aesthetic, plastic and reconstructive surgery includes procedures on the entire
    body: from hair transplantation, eyelid lift, nose correction or breast augmentation to
    abdominoplasty or scar correction – to name just a few examples. Procedures are performed both
    on an outpatient and inpatient basis and can be both personally and medically motivated. With
    our proven BRUMABA operating tables and operating chairs, we provide the ideal basis for the
    surgical steps especially for these often difficult applications. Because regardless of whether
    it is supine positioning, lateral positioning or abdominal positioning – thanks to the
    configurable positions, the surgeon always has optimal access to the patient and to the
    corresponding body region. This is also the case regardless of whether the surgeon prefers to
    perform the operation in a sitting or standing position. Sophisticated functionalities combined
    with easy handling and a wide range of accessories allow a perfect surgical procedure from
    preparation to cleaning. And for patients too, operating tables from BRUMABA ensure perfect
    relaxation thanks to particularly comfortable positioning on extra-soft, ergonomically shaped
    cushions. We will be happy to advise you on the choice of the ideal BRUMABA product and give you
    an overview of individual equipment options.*][42]
  * [Dermatology*Thanks to our close cooperation with dermatologists, we are able to understand your
    needs and ideas and develop individual solutions. Our specially designed BRUMABA operating
    tables and operating chairs offer customized solutions for dermatology / dermatosurgery and are
    an indispensable tool to provide you and your team with pleasant and ergonomic comfort even
    during longer operations.*][43]
  * [Orthopedics*The number of orthopedic and outpatient surgeries is increasing – among other
    things due to minimally invasive methods and the patient’s wish for a convalescence / recovery
    phase at home. Whether in day clinics, surgery clinics or in the practice – the outpatient
    specialties require the greatest possible flexibility in every case. The expectation of economic
    efficiency, uncompromising mobility and easy handling as well as hygienic cleaning of work
    equipment is therefore particularly high. A wide variety of requirements, from complicated or
    time-consuming surgical procedures to the need for a wide range of storage options and special
    economic efficiency, are optimally harmonized by BRUMABA products. They ensure a smooth process,
    from the preparation for surgery to the subsequent cleaning for the next operation. Among other
    things, recurring and complex storage procedures can be conveniently stored. And thanks to the
    extensive range of accessories, you equip each operating table entirely according to your needs.
    As entrepreneurs, we also have an eye on cost-effectiveness and can give you optimal advice. We
    would also be happy to come by in person and get an initial overview at your practice or
    clinic.*][44]
  * [Outpatient surgery*Numerous feedback and suggestions from surgeons in outpatient surgery
    centers are invaluable to us at BRUMABA. They help us to design innovative operating tables that
    are optimally tailored to your needs. With the help of your expertise, we not only refine our
    products technically, but also offer you the best comfort, highly functional ergonomics and
    maximum safety.*][45]
  * [ENT*Special solutions for ear, nose and throat (ENT) surgery make BRUMABA operating tables and
    operating chairs an indispensable tool for the operating area or procedure room. For example,
    for optimized head positioning during surgery on the tonsil organs, nasal septum, or middle ear:
    the narrow headrest on the operating table allows a better view of the surgical field with an
    ideal surgical distance without having to assume a stooped posture as a surgeon. The
    interoperatively precisely adjustable and easy-to-fix head tray enables particularly stable head
    positioning. The foot switch on the operating table is also particularly practical for
    consistent sterility and automated procedures. It allows functions to be self-regulated – a
    total of 8 memory programs are available that can be individually configured. Thanks to the
    unrestricted mobility of the BRUMABA operating tables, they can also be used for patient
    preparation as well as for transport or the recovery phase – without having to reposition the
    patient. Our BRUMABA products are already successfully in use in numerous ENT clinics and
    practices. We would be pleased to inform you about our portfolio and the many different
    possibilities for your individual configuration.*][46]
  * [Endodontics*Treatment tables and microsurgery chairs from BRUMABA enable an ideal working
    position and back-friendly treatment at the microscope for the doctor and assistant. Work safety
    is increased by an integrated microsurgery ring close to the head and individually adjustable
    forearm supports. Viscoelastic padding and flexible reclining positions ensure professional and
    comfortable patient positioning up to 300 kg.*][47]

# Exceptional Patient Experience

**DentPhix Clinics** offers affordable premium-quality dentistry in the heart of the Ortigas East
(formerly known as Frontera Verde) neighborhood in Pasig City, Philippines. A one-stop-shop for
specialty dental care established by the country's top dental experts, each recognized in their
respective fields, DentPhix's holistic approach to specialty dental servicing places it among the
dental clinics of choice for Pasig's elite and balikbayan, as well as neighborhood folk and city
dwellers alike.

The clinic also boasts high-tech equipment in partnership with DMD Diagnostics, guaranteeing
accuracy in diagnosis and resulting in the best treatment procedure possible. DentPhix also has good
infection control through **LISA autoclave**, the first in the country, which is at par with
**European Infection Control Standards**.

## Our Experienced Doctors

Our dentists take pride in their specialization and are constantly striving to contribute to their
respective fields. Read on to get to know more about the team and the passion behind the vocation.

Because every child has unique and special needs, DentPhix offers a range of dental services catered
especially to the little ones. We can’t promise anything pain-free, but we do promise to be extra
friendly about it!

(formerly known as Frontera Verde) neighborhood in Pasig City, Philippines. A one-stop-shop for
specialty dental care established by the country's top dental experts, each recognized in their
respective fields, DentPhix's holistic approach to specialty dental servicing places it among the
dental clinics of choice for Pasig's elite and balikbayan, as well as neighborhood folk and city
dwellers alike.

The clinic also boasts high-tech equipment in partnership with DMD Diagnostics, guaranteeing
accuracy in diagnosis and resulting in the best treatment procedure possible. DentPhix also has good
infection control through **LISA autoclave**, the first in the country, which is at par with
**European Infection Control Standards**.

## Our Fields of Expertise

From cleaning and polishing to surgeries and implants, from the most basic to the most specialized,

of dental services.

[ [Pediatric Dentistry | DentPhix Clinics] ][31]

#### Pediatric Dentistry

Because every child has unique and special needs, DentPhix offers a range of dental services catered
especially to the little ones. We can’t promise anything pain-free, but we do promise to be extra
friendly about it!
* [Read more about Pediatric Dentistry][32]

[ [Periodontics | DentPhix Clinics] ][33]

#### Periodontics

Troublesome gums? Something about your teeth that bothers you, though you can't quite point out
what? Consult our periodontic dentists to identify the problem – and have them solve it for you the
best way possible.
* [Read more about Periodontics][34]

[ [Endodontics (Root Canal Treatment) | DentPhix Clinics] ][35]

#### Endodontics (Root Canal Treatment)

Trust DentPhix’s highly trained and experienced team of dentists to handle you with care, as they
get to the root of your problem
* [Read more about Endodontics (Root Canal Treatment)][36]

[ [Orthodontics | DentPhix Clinics] ][37]

#### Orthodontics

Suffering from uneven bites, or an uncomfortable protrusion from your jaw? Not only will our expert
team of dentists fix things for you – they’ll do it in such a way that you may feel and look better
right after.
* [Read more about Orthodontics][38]

[ [Cosmetic Dentistry | DentPhix Clinics] ][39]

#### Cosmetic Dentistry

For star-quality pearly whites or simply a better-looking smile, DentPhix has all the services
you’ll need to improve your dental health, for both health and aesthetic purposes alike.
* [Read more about Cosmetic Dentistry][40]

[ [Implants | DentPhix Clinics] ][41]

#### Implants

At DentPhix, patients don’t shy away from their problems. Instead they present them boldly, even in
requesting a brand new tooth, faithful that we will deliver. And we do.
* [Read more about Implants][42]

[ [Oral Surgery | DentPhix Clinics] ][43]

#### Oral Surgery

Apart from dealing with cases more direct to the teeth, we also offer treatment for gum- and
teeth-related infections and diseases.
* [Read more about Oral Surgery][44]

[Dr Dhiraj Arora]

# Everything Endo.

Endodontic training, treatment referrals, speaker, lecturer & mentor

[Endodontic training ][15]

Dhiraj has designed popular courses that meet the needs of dentists who want to implement endodontic
treatment with a high level of skill and confidence.

 

He creates a small-group environment that allows for plenty of hands-on time and the opportunity to
ask questions. He also makes time for delegates after courses for advice and case guidance.  

[Endodontic referrals ][16]

Dr Dhiraj Arora works alongside dentists who prefer to refer patients for endodontic treatment or
more complex cases.

 

Patients will receive the very best care at one of our 3 practices in Twickenham, Gerrards Cross or
Slough.

[Endodontic presenter ][17]

Dhiraj is invited to present and speak on a variety of endodontic subjects across the world.

 

He also leads on workshops and other more interactive sessions. This includes taking workshops and
learning opportunities out to dental surgeries across the UK.

[Our latest article: "Excellence is not accidental"][18]

A-Z Everything Endo 3-day course

[Screenshot 2026-02-18 at 16.04.12.png]

The A-Z of Endodontics in Practice

June cohort


NEW DATES TO BE CONFIRMED


Join us for a 3-day, hands-on endodontic training course designed for general dental practitioners.
Whether you’re looking to sharpen your root canal skills or gain confidence with modern endodontic
techniques, this course delivers everything you need to handle daily endodontic procedures with
ease.


Led by Dr Dhiraj Arora, the training is practical, enjoyable and completely relatable. No lectures,
no stuffiness. Just real-world endodontic CPD in a relaxed, supportive environment. You’ll use the
latest equipment and materials while gaining valuable insight from Dhiraj’s engaging teaching style.
Always in small groups, the course is also supported across all three days by Dr Rob Devine, an
experienced, highly skilled endodontic practitioner.

[More info ][19]
[Course outline ][20]

About Dhiraj

I’m passionate about endo and loving the journey it has taken me on so far! As the owner of multiple
practices, several years as an associate corporate dentist, NHS experience, a masters in
endodontics, an honorary lecturer in endodontics (QMUL) and lots of other teaching experience, I am
able to take referrals and offer valuable and effective training courses.

more complex cases.

 

Patients will receive the very best care at one of our 3 practices in Twickenham, Gerrards Cross or
Slough.

[Endodontic presenter ][17]

Dhiraj is invited to present and speak on a variety of endodontic subjects across the world.

 

He also leads on workshops and other more interactive sessions. This includes taking workshops and
learning opportunities out to dental surgeries across the UK.

Join us for a 3-day, hands-on endodontic training course designed for general dental practitioners.
Whether you’re looking to sharpen your root canal skills or gain confidence with modern endodontic
techniques, this course delivers everything you need to handle daily endodontic procedures with
ease.


Led by Dr Dhiraj Arora, the training is practical, enjoyable and completely relatable. No lectures,
no stuffiness. Just real-world endodontic CPD in a relaxed, supportive environment. You’ll use the
latest equipment and materials while gaining valuable insight from Dhiraj’s engaging teaching style.
Always in small groups, the course is also supported across all three days by Dr Rob Devine, an
experienced, highly skilled endodontic practitioner.

## Les services et établissements

[Stéthoscope]

## Nos services hospitaliers

L'Hôpital Fondation Adolphe de Rothschild est spécialisé dans toutes les pathologies de la tête et
du cou des adultes et des enfants. Notre Hôpital Universitaire vous propose une prise en charge
d’excellence dans ses différents services hospitaliers.
* [Hôpital Fondation Adolphe de Rothschild][167]

[Consulter la liste des services][168]
[Hôpital]

## Nos centres de santé

Situés au plus près des patients et de leurs besoins, nos centres de santé spécialisés en
ophtalmologie participent aux actions de dépistage, de prévention et de promotion de leur santé
visuelle.
* [Centre de santé Edmond de Rothschild - Bauchat-Nation][169]
* [Centre de santé Edmond de Rothschild - Jaurès][170]

[En savoir plus][171]
[Stéthoscope]

## Nos filiales de santé

Une offre de soins complémentaire en secteur 2, alliant un haut niveau de confort à l'excellence
médicale.
* [Clinique Noémie de Rothschild][172]
* [Centre médical Argentine][173]

[En savoir plus][174]

## Instituts de recherche et centres d'expertises

[Microscope]

## Institut Français de Myopie (IFM)

1er institut en Europe dédié à la myopie. Dirigé par le Pr Aude Couturier, Cheffe de service
ophtalmologie à l’Hôpital Fondation Adolphe de Rothschild, il réunit sur un même site toutes les
expertises sur la myopie, en matière de soin, recherche, innovations, formation et il donne une
place phare aux patients et associations de patients.
* [Institut Français de Myopie (IFM)][175]

[En savoir plus][176]
[Microscope]

## Institut du Nerf Optique et du Glaucome - INOG

L'INOG, ou l'lnstitut du Nerf Optique et du Glaucome est un nouveau site de l’Hôpital Fondation
Adolphe de Rothschild, ouvert en 2025, dédié à la prise en charge de patients atteints du glaucome
et des autres maladies du nerf optique.
* [Institut du Nerf Optique et du Glaucome (INOG)][177]

[En savoir plus][178]
[Microscope]

## Centre d’expertise en implant cochléaire et auditif (CEICA)

Le Centre d’expertise en implant cochléaire et auditif (CEICA) de l’Hôpital Fondation Adolphe de
Rothschild est un centre référent implant cochléaire adulte en d’Ile de France spécialisé dans la
prise en charge des troubles auditifs de l'adulte.
* [Centre d’expertise en implant cochléaire et auditif (CEICA) ][179]

[En savoir plus][180]

## Soutenez nos projets

S'engager auprès de l'Hôpital Fondation Rothschild, c'est faire avancer la recherche pour changer la
vie des patients.

## Good. So Are We.

#### AI that Actually Works

Forget the buzzwords. At GAINS, AI isn’t a magic trick — it’s a practical tool we’ve been using for
decades built into the core of how decisions get made.

AI alone isn’t the answer — it’s just a tool. Without deep supply chain expertise, it’s just math in
a black box.

At GAINS, AI is embedded across our platform — but always guided by decades of real-world,
domain-specific knowledge. That’s how we turn intelligence into outcomes.

[ See How We Use AI ][124]

### Move Fast. No Overhauls. No Lock-In.

GAINS delivers real outcomes in weeks, not years.

No rip-and-replace. No vendor lock-in. No “trust the roadmap.”

We work with what you’ve got, plug in what you need, and help you move forward — one smart decision
at a time.

## What Got You Here Won’t Get You There.

Traditional systems weren’t built for the speed, volatility, or complexity of today’s supply chains.
They slow decisions, trap teams in outdated assumptions, and bury impact under layers of
disconnected tools.

Process-heavy approaches aren’t solving the problem — they’re compounding it.

That’s why we created DEO:
Decision Engineering & Orchestration®.

It’s not another layer of tech. It’s a smarter, connected way to make and execute high-impact supply
chain decisions — across every time to plan horizon, from strategic design to daily execution.

DEO® brings speed, clarity, and precision to how your supply chain thinks and responds. So you’re
not just reacting faster — you’re creating value faster.

into planning and execution workflows. No handoffs, no siloed strategies—just a connected,
continuously improving system.

emerge. You’re never locked in—just always ahead

strategies, run simulations, and ensure implementation sticks with our battle-tested proprietary
Proven-Path-to-Performance (P3) methodology and our Solutions Council of industry experts.

## Frequently Asked Questions

[

View All FAQ's

][25]

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits, medication and supplies, and ongoing
care included.

How does Henry work?

Henry makes it easy to get the personalized care you need in just a few steps. Answer a few
questions about your health and goals. A licensed healthcare provider will review your information
and recommend treatment if necessary. If prescribed, you’ll get your medication by mail within a few
days. There’s no insurance stress or surprise bills. Just one monthly payment that includes your
provider visit, medication and supplies, and ongoing care.

Who can use Henry?

Henry is open to all adults! To use Henry, you must: Be 18 years or older. Have a demonstrated
medical need for treatment. Live or have an address in one of the states we support.

How do I see a provider?

Click any “Get Started” button and answer a few questions about your health and lifestyle goals.
You’ll then be able to schedule a provider visit face-to-face with a video call, or depending on
your home state, choose an independent provider review without a video call. You and your provider
will be able to exchange messages through our secure patient portal.

Does Henry require a long-term contract?

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

What if I need to cancel?

You can cancel at any time in your account page of the patient portal, by contacting our support
team at ask@henrymeds.com, or by calling 909-787-2342. If you’re on a multi-month plan, you may be
required to pay out the rest of your balance unless you’re unable to continue for medical-related
reasons as determined by a healthcare provider.

What is compounded medication?

Compounded medication is prescription medicine from a licensed provider that’s custom-made by a
licensed pharmacist. Instead of a one-size-fits-all drug from big manufacturers, the pharmacist will
mix or adjust ingredients in compounded medication to tailor to your specific needs. Because these
medications are customized, they’re not FDA-approved in the same way as commercial drugs, but they
do use FDA-approved ingredients.

Do I need insurance?

No, you don’t need insurance! Henry makes it easy to get the care you need without having to deal
with insurance claims. Your provider visits, medication and supplies, shipping, and ongoing care are
all included in your plan price—without any hidden or surprise fees.

*If medically eligible

No long-term contracts! Henry offers convenient monthly plans, as well as longer term plans for
certain treatments. You can easily cancel any time.

How soon will I receive my medication?

Most people receive their medication within 8-10 business days after they speak to their provider.
Just a heads up, people in California may experience longer fulfillment times because of additional
compound testing requirements.

What if I need to cancel?

You can cancel at any time in your account page of the patient portal, by contacting our support
team at ask@henrymeds.com, or by calling 909-787-2342. If you’re on a multi-month plan, you may be
required to pay out the rest of your balance unless you’re unable to continue for medical-related
reasons as determined by a healthcare provider.

What is compounded medication?

Compounded medication is prescription medicine from a licensed provider that’s custom-made by a
licensed pharmacist. Instead of a one-size-fits-all drug from big manufacturers, the pharmacist will
mix or adjust ingredients in compounded medication to tailor to your specific needs. Because these
medications are customized, they’re not FDA-approved in the same way as commercial drugs, but they
do use FDA-approved ingredients.

Do I need insurance?

No, you don’t need insurance! Henry makes it easy to get the care you need without having to deal
with insurance claims. Your provider visits, medication and supplies, shipping, and ongoing care are
all included in your plan price—without any hidden or surprise fees.

*If medically eligible

## Frequently Asked Questions

[

View All FAQ's

][27]

What is Henry?

Henry is a telehealth service that makes it easy and affordable to get the medical care you need. We
help people manage weight loss, perimenopause and testosterone hormone therapies, and erectile
dysfunction, as well as other conditions. It’s easy to get started—just answer a few questions about
your health and lifestyle goals, and we’ll connect you with an expert provider. If medically
approved, you’ll get your prescribed medication by mail within a week. There’s no insurance
required. Just a simple monthly bill with your provider visits

database, and investor presentations are also good tool for information to make appropriate
iterative validation are used to modify market models and cross-verify primary research and

The comfort and care of our patients are of the utmost importance. Our practices are designed to be
spacious and modern, equipped with advanced technology that fosters an environment that provides
patient ease and confidence in their treatment.

endodontic specialists using modern technology.

  We remove infected tissue from inside a tooth, clean the canal, and seal it to save the natural
  tooth. Most visits take 60 to 90 minutes, in a single appointment.
  
  Learn about Root Canal Therapy ][71]
* [
  
  ### Emergency Root Canal Treatment
  
  Severe tooth pain seen the same day you call. Same-day appointments at offices across Central
  Florida, by endodontic specialists, with 3D CBCT imaging and surgical microscopes.
  
  Learn about Emergency Root Canal Treatment ][72]
* [
  
  ### Root Canal Retreatment
  
  If a previously treated tooth becomes infected again, retreatment clears the old filling, cleans
  the canals, and reseals the tooth. It saves the natural tooth in most cases, without extraction.
  
  Learn about Root Canal Retreatment ][73]

Why MFE

## Endodontics is all we do.

01

### Specialists only

Every MFE provider is an endodontic specialist with years of advanced training beyond dental school.
We do one thing, and we do it exceptionally well.

02

### Modern technology

Digital CBCT imaging, surgical microscopes, and computerized anesthesia delivery. We invest in the
tools that make root canals faster and more comfortable.

03

### Patient comfort first

You’re here because you’re nervous. We get it. Our team is trained to make every step, from the
first phone call to the final restoration, as reassuring and unhurried as possible.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate
everywhere.

# What is the Model Context Protocol (MCP)?

Copy pageCopy page
Copy pageCopy page
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open-source standard for connecting AI applications to external
systems. Using MCP, AI applications like Claude or ChatGPT can connect to data sources (e.g. local
files, databases), tools (e.g. search engines, calculators) and workflows (e.g. specialized
prompts)—enabling them to access key information and perform tasks. Think of MCP like a USB-C port
for AI applications. Just as USB-C provides a standardized way to connect electronic devices, MCP
provides a standardized way to connect AI applications to external systems.

## [
## ][30]
## What can MCP enable?
* Agents can access your Google Calendar and Notion, acting as a more personalized AI assistant.
* Claude Code can generate an entire web app using a Figma design.
* Enterprise chatbots can connect to multiple databases across an organization, empowering users to
  analyze data using chat.
* AI models can create 3D designs on Blender and print them out using a 3D printer.

## [
## ][31]
## Why does MCP matter?

Depending on where you sit in the ecosystem, MCP can have a range of benefits.
* **Developers**: MCP reduces development time and complexity when building, or integrating with, an
  AI application or agent.
* **AI applications or agents**: MCP provides access to an ecosystem of data sources, tools and apps
  which will enhance capabilities and improve the end-user experience.
* **End-users**: MCP results in more capable AI applications or agents which can access your data
  and take actions on your behalf when necessary.

## [
## ][32]
## Broad ecosystem support

MCP is an open protocol supported across a wide range of clients and servers. AI assistants like
[Claude][33] and [ChatGPT][34], development tools like [Visual Studio Code][35], [Cursor][36],
[MCPJam][37], and many others all support MCP — making it easy to build once and integrate

NYU Langone Dental Medicine Postdoctoral Residency Programs is nationally recognized and affiliated
with community health center, university, and hospital sites that train nearly 400 residents
annually. With locations in 29 US states, Puerto Rico, and the US Virgin Islands, we are the largest
dental residency program with new sites added annually.

to excellence in patient care, education, and research.

### AEGD Alumni CE Event

VPT

][75]

## Training Sites

NYU Langone Dental Medicine Postdoctoral Residency Programs is nationally recognized and affiliated
with community health center, university, and hospital sites that train nearly 400 residents
annually. With locations in 29 US states, Puerto Rico, and the US Virgin Islands, we are the largest
dental residency program with new sites added annually.

## Our Mission

To Serve, To Teach, and To Discover. Achieved daily through our integrated academic culture devoted
to excellence in patient care, education, and research.

# Meet the Doctors


# Meet the Doctors


**Stuart M. Patterson, DDS**

                Dr. Stuart Patterson received his undergraduate degree in Criminal Justice from
Appalachian State University and completed his graduate dental degree from UNC-Chapel Hill School of
Dentistry in 2006.  He is a member of American Dental Association, North Carolina Dental Society and
the Alamance-Caswell Dental Society.  A Burlington native, Dr. Stuart and his wife, Crissy, have 1
daughter (Emily).  He enjoys time with family, being outdoors, and spending time in the mountains.

Left to Right: Crissy, Emily, Boone and Dr. Stuart.

**Nathan W. Patterson, DDS**

                Dr. Nathan Patterson received his undergraduate degree in Biology from UNC-Chapel
Hill and completed his graduate degree from UNC-Chapel Hill School of Dentistry in 2014.  He is a
member of the American Dental Association and the North Carolina Dental Society.  During his last
year of school Dr. Nathan was selected by the director of Operative Dentistry to be a teaching
assistant in the Conservative Operative Dentistry course, helping teach pre-doctoral dental students
learn the basics of restorative dentistry.  A Burlington native, Dr. Nathan and his wife,
Tiffany, have one son (Nolan) and one daughter (Finley).  He enjoys spending time with friends and
family, sports, and traveling. Dr. Nathan’s wife (Tiffany) is a doctor of physical therapy and is
currently a home health physical therapist, so be on the lookout for her if you’ve had a recent
joint replacement as she may just end up as your therapist.

Left to Right: Dr. Nathan, Finley, Nolan and Dr. Tiffany.

**David S. Patterson, DDS**

**                **Dr. David Patterson received his undergraduate degree in Chemistry from Elon
University and completed his graduate dental degree from UNC-Chapel Hill School of Dentistry in
1982.  He is a member of the American Dental Association, North Carolina Dental Society and the
Alamance-Caswell Dental Society.  Dr. David has also served on the Board of Directors for the UNC
Dental Alumni Association and the Alamance County Board of Health.  Born in Roanoke, Virginia, Dr.
David moved to Burlington at the age of 5 and has since been a lifelong resident of Alamance
County.  He and his wife, Ruth, have 3 sons, 3 grandsons and 2 granddaughters.  He enjoys time with
family, boating, travel, playing electric guitar and spending time at the coast. You will not catch
Dr. David in the office much these days, unless he is here for his own dental appointment or the
occasional social visit :-)

[Top][22]

**PHONE**

(336) 226-9078

**HOURS**

Monday - Thursday 7am - 3pm

**LOCATION**

2879 Rob Shepard Drive

Alamance, NC 27201

[The Team]

### Our Team

Dr. Brar and the staff at Patterson Family Dental provide quality dental care to patients in the
Patterson area, focusing on a comprehensive approach to oral health. By treating and educating
patients, our team helps patients to stay healthy in between visits. Our staff understands the
importance of listening to patients, helping them to feel comfortable and relaxed. This personal
approach is evident in everything we do. From making an appointment, filling out paperwork,
conducting an examination, and providing dental treatments, the staff at Patterson Family Dental
take the time to connect with patients and give them the thoughtful attention they deserve. Our team
is trained on advanced dental procedures and techniques so that patients can benefit from the latest
in dental care.

[About Us][98]
[Our Services]

### Our Services

Patterson Family Dental provides a wide variety of dental services and procedures to address all of
our patients' dental health needs. By combining quality patient care with up-to-date technology, we
are able to treat patients of all ages in a comfortable and relaxing setting. Our website includes
information on the following items: Invisalign Dentist, Cosmetic Dentist, Dental Crowns, Dental
Office, Dental Veneers, Dentures, Emergency Dentist, Family Dentist, Teeth Whitening, Tooth
Extraction and more. Our Dentist and experienced staff are trained to not only treat patients but to
identify what caused the health concern in the first place. This comprehensive approach sets
patients of Patterson Family Dental on the road to recovery and long term oral health.

[View Our Services][99]
[Patient Information]

### Patient Information

When you walk into the office of Patterson Family Dental you will be immediately greeted by our
friendly staff who are dedicated to making sure that you feel comfortable during your entire
appointment. We understand that patients can feel anxious when going to the dentist, and our staff
will take the time to listen to all of your concerns and help you understand exactly what your
procedure is going to be like. At Patterson Family Dental we pride ourselves on being an affordable
family dentist that accepts a variety of insurance plans and payment options, like cash and credit
cards, because we want to provide a beautiful, healthy smile to everyone in the Patterson area. Call
Patterson Family Dental today at 209-585-1472 to see why we are the dentist of choice in the
Patterson area.

conducting an examination, and providing dental treatments, the staff at Patterson Family Dental
take the time to connect with patients and give them the thoughtful attention they deserve. Our team
is trained on advanced dental procedures and techniques so that patients can benefit from the latest
in dental care.

[About Us][98]
[Our Services]

### Our Services

Patterson Family Dental provides a wide variety of dental services and procedures to address all of
our patients' dental health needs. By combining quality patient care with up-to-date technology, we
are able to treat patients of all ages in a comfortable and relaxing setting. Our website includes
information on the following items: Invisalign Dentist, Cosmetic Dentist, Dental Crowns, Dental
Office, Dental Veneers, Dentures, Emergency Dentist, Family Dentist, Teeth Whitening, Tooth
Extraction and more. Our Dentist and experienced staff are trained to not only treat patients but to
identify what caused the health concern in the first place. This comprehensive approach sets
patients of Patterson Family Dental on the road to recovery and long term oral health.

[View Our Services][99]
[Patient Information]

### Patient Information

When you walk into the office of Patterson Family Dental you will be immediately greeted by our
friendly staff who are dedicated to making sure that you feel comfortable during your entire
appointment. We understand that patients can feel anxious when going to the dentist, and our staff
will take the time to listen to all of your concerns and help you understand exactly what your
procedure is going to be like. At Patterson Family Dental we pride ourselves on being an affordable
family dentist that accepts a variety of insurance plans and payment options, like cash and credit
cards, because we want to provide a beautiful, healthy smile to everyone in the Patterson area. Call
Patterson Family Dental today at 209-585-1472 to see why we are the dentist of choice in the
Patterson area.
